description: PyTorch-engine replication runs (2026-09-23, clean sequential pass, fresh process per run, original per-engine virtual environments from data/environment.json). These validate the 2026-09-22 reference measurements in data/results and data/optimization.
workload: same 8-file subset as data/optimization (ASR); corpus sentences zh/en for qwen3-tts; zero-shot zh prompt case for cosyvoice

qwen3-tts bf16 t16 (zh+en, 2 sentences).note: pass 1 zh was a cold-process outlier (2.75); warm passes only

cosyvoice t16 zero-shot zh.note: pass 1 was a cold-process outlier (6.19); warm passes only

protocol_notes: Runs executed strictly sequentially; an earlier parallel attempt (benchmark + PyTorch chains concurrent) inflated RTF up to 2x and was discarded.

The reference host is shared and non-exclusive (approx. 2 cores of ambient services). Differences vs the 2026-09-22 reference values reflect ambient CPU load at run time, not elapsed time; these runs predate automatic load recording (environment.runtime), so their load state is unknown. See pinned/ runs for load-attributed evidence and METHODOLOGY.md section 6.
Within-process cv for the ONNX engines (asr_*.json here) is 2-5%; cross-process means track the ambient load almost linearly.
